COT-00.lema: The ones who were on the drive.
COT-00.tipoNota: Commando: a unit assembled for one mission that became permanent (doc 02). If it survives AVE-01, it can become a Cerberus or Regency coterie, depending on the Ending (doc 08).
COT-00.dominio: The Harbor Island docks, around David's hangar
COT-00.descripcion: A coterie born of a shared threat: every one of them is in the Ward File, and either they get it back together or they go down together.
trasfondos: Haven 3 (the hangar, on loan from David): with Water Access and Arsenal
Ally: David Smith (PJ-01), built in. He helps because he goes down with them
Ally: Tom “Bear” Whitman (PNJ-05), shared with David
trasfondosDoc02: Haven (the hangar, on loan from David)
alternativas: B) it's a coterie that already existed, and Montgomery uses it as a strike force
C) they're strangers who happen to be in Helen's apartment the night of the theft

dominioNotas.caza: Night-shift workers. Feeding is possible, but you have to be careful.
dominioNotas.lien: The coterie has barely any sway over the mortals at the port. Bear knows a few of them.
dominioNotas.portillon: Lots of access points, containers, and water. Easy to get in and out. For enemies, too.

COT-01.dominio: The farm and the Snohomish Valley
COT-01.descripcion: The ones who clean up the city while the Prince raises a glass in the Gallery.

dominioNotas.lien: the town sees them as an odd family of dog breeders
dominioNotas.portillon: open fields, dogs, a single gravel road, and the tunnel to the river

COT-02.lema: The ones who look down from above.
COT-02.descripcion: A Primogen, his childe, two ghouls, and an investment fund. None of them uses the word “conspiracy.”

dominioNotas.lien: half of Bellevue works for someone who works for Halloway
dominioNotas.portillon: private elevators, ghoul security, ANOMALY cameras

COT-03.dominio: The old shipyard and the Port of Everett
COT-03.descripcion: The Anarchs of the Everett shipyard: they vote, they weld, and they owe nothing to any Prince.

dominioNotas.caza: welders and longshoremen, some of them willing
dominioNotas.portillon: a single highway, but the water has no doors

COT-04.descripcion: The brokers of the Seattle Underground: the stone of 1889 and the cables of 2026.

dominioNotas.caza: homeless people, in exchange for shelter
dominioNotas.lien: doormen, cleaners, and technicians all over the city
dominioNotas.portillon: nobody enters the Sealed Underground without Thornquist knowing
